title: Remove GitHub Actions runtime, cache, and Homebrew trust warnings
rawUserRequest: Fix the GitHub Actions warnings before release: upgrade the Node.js-20 upload-artifact action; stop setup-go cache restore warnings caused by the intentionally absent repository-root go.mod; remove the unrelated untrusted aws/tap before Swift Homebrew operations without disabling trust checks; receive Dependabot PR #443 in this governed corrective; verify the warnings are absent in exact-Head Hosted runs; then continue without stopping.

declaredIntent.summary: Remove three diagnosed GitHub Actions warning classes with durable workflow assertions and exact-Head Hosted evidence before release.

outOfScope: Disabling GitHub Actions Node runtime enforcement or Homebrew tap trust globally.
Adding a fake repository-root go.mod solely to satisfy setup-go caching.
Trusting the entire aws/tap or any unrelated third-party Homebrew tap.
Changing supported language/toolchain versions except the pinned actions/upload-artifact update already proposed by Dependabot PR #443.
Merging Dependabot PRs #441, #442, #444, or #445; each remains a later independent governed Work Item.
Publishing a release, changing release metadata, creating a tag, or changing a GitHub Release.

sources.reason: Contains the upload-artifact v4 SHA that emitted the Node.js 20 deprecation warning in Actions run 30420914133.
Contains the two setup-go fixture steps and two Swift Homebrew operations that emitted warnings in Actions run 30421167605.
Existing executable workflow-contract tests for compatibility jobs and pinned tool behavior.
Existing executable assertions for the smoke diagnostic artifact path.
Authoritative serial pre-release plan and instruction-plan-implementation-acceptance traceability context.
Sole authority for current implementation status and generated source binding when workflows or tests change.

riskAssessment.reason: Workflow action pins and hosted runner bootstrap behavior affect every PR and release evidence run; a broad trust bypass or false local-only success would leave the release path exposed.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly approved fixing the reported Actions warnings and receiving Dependabot PRs before release.

preReviewWarnings: A successful job is insufficient: inspect exact-Head Hosted logs and prove each named warning string is absent.
Keep action references pinned to immutable full commit SHAs and bind the upload-artifact pin to Dependabot PR #443.
Do not disable Homebrew trust enforcement or invent dependency manifests to silence warnings.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A1: smoke.yml pins actions/upload-artifact v7.0.1 commit 043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a, preserving diagnostic upload behavior and explicitly recording that this receives Dependabot PR #443.

A2: both setup-go fixture/probe steps disable setup-go dependency caching because their go.mod is created later inside a temporary project; no fake root go.mod or cache-dependency-path workaround is introduced.
A3: both Swift Homebrew paths remove only aws/tap when it is present before invoking brew; the workflow does not trust aws/tap, disable tap trust checks, or ignore untap failures.

A4: executable regression tests fail if the upload action regresses, either Go step re-enables implicit caching, either Swift path omits the narrow untap guard, or a prohibited broad trust bypass appears.
A5: local focused workflow tests, quality-fast, full quality, ai-finish archive, and aggregate PR verification pass.

A6: exact-Head Hosted smoke and compatibility runs pass; their logs contain none of the Node.js 20/upload-artifact, missing go.mod cache restore, or untrusted aws/tap warning signatures reported by the user.

A7: the user instruction, plan, Contract, workflow changes, tests, Summary, hosted evidence, and acceptance IDs are bidirectionally traceable; Capability Truth remains the implementation-status authority.
A8: PR merge, ai-close-work-item, local/remote branch deletion, worktree cleanup, and synchronized clean main complete before the next Dependabot Work Item starts.
A9: Dependabot PR #443 is closed as superseded only after the governed replacement is merged; #441, #442, #444, and #445 remain unchanged and queued before release.
guidelines: Use immutable full-SHA GitHub Action pins and record the upstream version represented by each changed pin.
Fix the actual runner/bootstrap mismatch instead of suppressing warning systems.
Apply the narrowest Homebrew cleanup: remove only the unrelated aws/tap when present.
Prove Hosted warning absence from exact-Head logs; local YAML tests alone are not sufficient.
Complete one Work Item, branch, and PR lifecycle before starting the next dependency intake.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add positive and prohibited-bypass assertions, then inspect exact-Head Swift job logs.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Repository workflow tests fail closed before merge.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run mutation-style assertions over the workflow text for every required and prohibited marker.

intent.problem: Successful GitHub Actions runs still emit three warning classes: an upload-artifact release targeting Node.js 20, setup-go cache restoration before temporary Go modules exist, and an unrelated untrusted aws/tap on hosted macOS. These warnings hide future actionable failures and are on the pre-release path.
constraints: Preserve immutable action pinning and accept the exact upload-artifact v7.0.1 SHA proposed by Dependabot PR #443.
Do not add a fake root go.mod; the jobs intentionally create disposable modules after toolchain setup.
Do not trust aws/tap or disable Homebrew trust checks; remove only that unrelated tap when present.
Require exact-Head Hosted log evidence, not successful conclusions alone.
Do not modify or merge the other four Dependabot PRs in this Work Item.
intent.rationale: Narrow workflow corrections plus fail-closed regression assertions eliminate the diagnosed causes without weakening supply-chain controls or changing project toolchain support.
